description: Header file defining functions, constants, and data structures for managing associated devices' harvesting status, reporting, polling periods, and related configurations in a harvester system.

methods.name: SetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for associated devices, enabling or disabling harvesting.

methods.name: GetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period in seconds.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting period in seconds.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period in seconds.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling period in seconds.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout in seconds after which IDW intervals revert to default.

methods.name: SetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout in seconds for accelerated IDW polling.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout in seconds for IDW override.

methods.name: ValidateIDWPeriod
methods.description: Validates if the given period is within the acceptable range.

methods.name: isvalueinarray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the schema buffer for IDW.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaBufferSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the IDW schema buffer.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaIDBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the schema ID buffer for IDW.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaIDBufferSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the IDW schema ID buffer.

methods.name: NumberofElementsinLinkedList
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the associated device linked list.

methods.name: NumberofDevicesinLinkedList
methods.description: Returns the number of devices in the linked list.

methods.name: harvester_avro_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of avro resources.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeString
methods.description: Returns the current time as a string.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeInSecond
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds.

methods.name: parseInputValue
methods.description: Extracts radio index value from input string (RDK_ONEWIFI specific).
